mapper.select: SELECT n.id AS newsId, n.title AS newsTitle, n.category AS category, COUNT(u.id)::int AS registrationCount, COALESCE( string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username), ',' ORDER BY COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username)), '' ) AS studentNicknames FROM news n LEFT JOIN registration r ON n.id = r.news_id LEFT JOIN "user" u ON r.user_id = u.id AND u.role = 0 WHERE n.is_competition = TRUE OR n.category = '网络安全活动' GROUP BY n.id, n.title, n.category ORDER BY n.id DESC
